title: Runner
leads: Nobody. You look after every phone in your bag, from one signature to the next.
where: On the road between the sites on one side of the city and their nearest hub
hours: Evenings and nights. From the end of the site's shift to 10:00 PM, then the return before 7:00 AM
summary: You carry a site's phones to the hub every night and bring them back before 7:00 AM, signed for at both ends.

posting.headline: Runner (night phone runs), Cairo
posting.about: We run video recording teams at factories, warehouses, farms, and construction sites across Cairo. Workers wear a small camera on a cap while they do their normal job. Every night the phones go to an upload hub and come back before the morning shift. A runner makes that trip, with every phone counted and signed for at both ends.
do: Work evenings and nights, from the end of the site's shift to before 7:00 AM.
Count the site's phones with the Portfolio Manager. Both of you sign the phone list.
Take all of a site's phones in one trip, in the provided bag.
Drive straight to the nearest hub. Never stop. Be there before 10:00 PM.
Count again with the hub attendant and sign. Then the same at your next site.
In the morning, bring the cleared phones back and sign them over before 7:00 AM.
At a checkpoint, show the letter and the phone list. Stay calm. Call your manager.
Report any absence by 8:00 PM the night before.
need: A national ID and a valid driving licence.
Careful with equipment and honest with numbers.
Calm with people, even at a checkpoint. You never argue.
plus: You have worked as a driver or a courier before.
You know your side of Cairo at night.
offer: A steady monthly wage, paid on time.
Paid training, and your trainer next to you on your first run.
A clear job with a clear list.
The company letter and two numbers that always answer. Never alone on the road.
posting.apply: Send your name, your age, your area, your phone number, and whether you have a driving licence. We call you back within two working days.

offer.heading: Offer of employment
paragraphs: We are pleased to offer you the position of Runner at KMSC. You will report to {manager}, Director of Operations.
Your start date is {start}. You start with one hour of paid training, then your first run with your trainer.

terms.label: Place of work
terms.v: The hubs and sites of one side of the city. Home hub: {site}.

terms.label: Hours
terms.v: Evenings and nights, at the hub by 10:00 PM and back before 7:00 AM

terms.label: Pay
terms.v: {pay} per month, paid at the end of the month

conditions: A copy of your national ID and your driving licence.
Your signature on the consent form and the fraud briefing.
One account in your own name. Accounts are never shared.
The one-hour training and your first run, signed off by your trainer.
expect: Every run is at the hub before 10:00 PM, or it does not leave.
Every phone you sign for at one end is signed in at the other.
You never stop on the way. A phone that goes home with you ends the job.
offer.closing: Please sign below to accept this offer. We look forward to working with you.

handbook.purpose: The client pays only for footage that reaches them. A full phone that sleeps at the site is a lost day. You carry the site's phones to the hub every night and bring them back empty before the operators clock in. Every handover is counted and signed.
outcomes: Every site's phones at the hub before 10:00 PM, every night.
Every cleared phone back at its site, signed for, before 7:00 AM.
Two signatures on the phone list at every handover.
Moharam hears about a problem from the road, not the next morning.
daily: Evening. Tonight's runs from the Portfolio Manager. Check the letter kit.
Pickup. Count by device number against the phone list. Both sign. Bag closed, bag on you.
On the road. Straight to the hub. No fuel, no food, no passenger, no errand.
At the hub. Count with the hub attendant. Both sign.
Next site. Same again, one bag per site. Last drop before 10:00 PM.
Early morning. Collect the cleared phones. New list, both sign. Held phones stay.
Before 7:00 AM. Hand the bag to the operator. Count together. Both sign.
By 8:00 PM the night before. Tell Moharam about any absence.
weekly: Thursday night. The full flush: every phone from every site goes to the hub.
Once a week. Check the bag and the letter kit. Replace what is worn.
monthly: Go through the month's runs with Moharam. Agree on what to change.
standards: One bag per site, all of its phones, nothing on the outside.
The phone list is in the bag, signed by both sides at pickup and at drop.
The letter kit rides on every run. No letter, no run.
MDM tracking is on while the phones travel.
Sign only the real count. A wrong number is a call to Moharam.
never: A run that cannot reach the hub by 10:00 PM does not leave.
Never stop on the way, for anything.
A phone that goes home with you ends the job.
Never argue with the police, and never hide the count.
Saying the client's name to anyone outside the company ends the job.

firstMonth.what: One hour with Moharam: the bag, the list, the letter kit, the checkpoint answer.
Your trainer rides with you. You do every count and every signature yourself.
You run your sites alone. Moharam checks your signed lists every morning.
You pass the quiz, know the checkpoint answer by heart, and every run is on time.

measures: Runs at the hub before 10:00 PM, every night.
Phones back at the site, signed, before 7:00 AM.
Two signatures at every handover. No gaps.
Counts that did not match, per month.
handbook.call: Moharam, for everything, at any hour. A late run, a wrong count, the police, a crash, a theft: call him now. If the police keep a phone, Mano brings a lawyer the same day.
